scripts.contracts:generate: node scripts/python.mjs apps/server/scripts/export_contracts.py && json2ts contracts/protocol.schema.json --output apps/web/src/generated/protocol.ts
scripts.lint: pnpm lint:web && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff check apps/server && node scripts/python.mjs -m ruff format --check apps/server
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @holdem/web typecheck && node scripts/python.mjs -m mypy apps/server/app
scripts.test: pnpm test:web && node scripts/python.mjs -m pytest apps/server/tests
